purpose: Compare local-only OCR on the user supplied annotated bilingual textbook photographs. No dictionary correction or answer substitution.

method.productionSimulation: High-quality sample 12MP source to 6*1024*1024 pixel budget; vertical closing radii 0/5/9 at 2172x2896; sample each mask to longest dimension 1600; same eng+chi_sim worker PSM3, no autorotate; retain highest-confidence overlapping line.
limits: Color enhancement applies only to blue/cyan ink; original mixed-language pass is still required to retain uncolored terms.
Annotation strokes can physically cover glyphs; confidence is heuristic, not a correctness guarantee.
Results depend on resampling and segmentation. Browser canvas still requires integration-level acceptance.
The week entry retains an initial-capital recognition difference (Week).
Textbook Chinese meanings were not validated by this color-mask experiment.
